comparison.objective: Release one terminal block from a DIN rail and place it in a tray without disturbing neighbors.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine screwdriver insertion, spring-latch release, tipping, and extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Target block is released and deposited while adjacent blocks remain latched.
comparison.reason: This is snap-latch disassembly; it neither sets an adjustable stop nor counterholds a screw while tightening a nut.
